author: Benjinsmith
desc:
A 3D model of an evil rabbit.  The goal was to create something recognisable from nature, yet something that was warped, made evil or abominable. 
 The textures are done in a painterly style, with subtle details on large areas punctuated by bright contrast in some places. 
 Stats: 602 triangles 512x Texture 
 Includes: Rabbit Model Diffuse Texture 3 Animations: Idle, Run, and Attack

author: Djsedj
desc: Important to note is that the mouth is pretty rough (no teeth, tongue or anything). This model is actually a by-product of me designing an actual character earlier. Too bad that character's jaws don't suit a regular lagomorph...
